description: This file defines a UserController class in an ASP.NET Core web application, responsible for handling user-related actions such as retrieving current user info and logging out. It interacts with authentication services, manages cookies, and constructs user information from claims.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Controller handling user-related endpoints such as retrieving current user info and logout functionality.

methods.name: GetCurrentUser
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current authenticated user's information.

methods.name: Logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user, clears relevant cookies, updates cache, and logs the event.

methods.name: CreateUserInfo
methods.description: Constructs a UserInfo object based on the claims in a ClaimsPrincipal.
